explanation: In a popular legend the animals raced across a river, and the rat rode on the ox's back before leaping ahead at the finish. The pig comes last.

claims.text: The rat is the first animal in the 12-year cycle of the Chinese zodiac.
In the Chinese zodiac the ox is second, the tiger third and the dragon fifth, so none of them comes first.
A popular legend tells of a race across a river in which the rat rode on the ox's back and jumped ahead to finish first.
The pig is the last of the 12 animals of the Chinese zodiac.
